newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area early Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested.
Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. 76,300 head confirmed for week to date which includes 30,600 head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
The latest established market was $63.00 per cwt on Tuesday. Wednesday's packer bids were $62.00, with asking prices $63.00-$64.00. Confirmed - None.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
